title: MA61012: Parallel Algorithms
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
Addition of numbers, matrix multiplication, evaluation of arithmetic
expressions, sorting, 0-1 knapsack problem, minimum spanning tree, traversal of
trees, searching in a graph, analysis of time complexity and number of
processors used, lower bound theory of parallel computation. Parallelism in
computers - SIMD and MIMD models.
